g.text: Recorded API charges, projected full-evaluation cost, and median time per example, including tool turns.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717e

g.text: Priced models are ordered by projected cost, highest first; unpriced models follow. Mochi SFT 400407 is highlighted.

text.style: font-size: 9.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717e

g.text: Full-cost estimates scale each condition’s pilot mean to 840 easy and 790 hard cases, each with and without Python.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717e

g.text: — No per-request price. † GPT-OSS billing is incomplete for 19 cases; hatched costs and projections are lower bounds.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717e

g.text: Latency includes failures and tool turns. P90 times, concurrency, request deadlines and cost assumptions are in the accompanying tables.
